title: PDF Flow Reader
user: Knowledge workers with low vision who need long PDFs to read as stable, keyboard-first reflowed prose rather than zoomed page images or broken screen-reader line fragments.
smallest_useful_product: A browser-based local PDF reader with a single-column reflow mode, adjustable line/word spacing and contrast, heading navigation, keyboard reading position, and an explicit extraction-confidence warning.
success_measure: In moderated sessions, 8 of 10 low-vision users can resume a saved reading position and complete a 10-minute reading task with fewer viewer switches than their normal workflow.
constraints: Keep documents on-device; respect encrypted/permission-protected PDFs; do not claim text extraction fixes a source document's WCAG compliance; maintain keyboard and screen-reader accessibility of the tool itself.
